effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By placing 1 Digimon card with [Gammamon] in its name from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, it gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and +3000 DP until your opponent's turn ends.
inherited_effect_description_eng: ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
